name: Piercing Rays
primary:
Five thin white rays fire one after another from five rune circles around you toward your aim, up to 64 blocks. Each ray pierces every creature on its path:
• Damage 2 ❤ arcane per ray, up to 10 ❤ in total
self_description:
Defensive magic. A rune circle stands in front of you for 5 s and turns with your gaze:
• Stops arrows and other shots that fly into it
• Blocks every hit that comes from the front
